valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing (Nasdaq GILD common), no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance is a loss of $(1.20) to $(0.85) (raised Oct 29 2026), which includes about $12.4B of acquired IPR&D (about $9.88 per share, Arcellx, Tubulis, Ouro, PepStar, net of Lakefront). Excluding acquired IPR&D, acquisition financing costs and nonrecurring other revenue, the company's illustrative non-GAAP EPS range is $8.75-$9.10 (about $8.93 midpoint, from the Zacks summary of the release). FY2027 EPS is my own assumption: the company gives no 2027 financial guidance. Diluted shares about 1.24-1.25B. Base assumes low-to-mid single-digit EPS growth from HIV (Biktarvy, Yeztugo), Trodelvy and Livdelzi, with no new large IPR&D charge in the forecast year. A future business-development charge would cut reported EPS. Biktarvy Medicare Maximum Fair Price starts Jan 1 2028, after the FY2027 earnings year but within the horizon, so it is a bear-case driver for the 2027 multiple.

bear.driver: Biktarvy pricing pressure ahead of the 2028 Medicare price, HIV competition and Veklury erosion compress sales growth; investors pay a lower multiple for a flat-to-down earnings stream and the IPR&D run-rate continues.

base.driver: Underlying EPS grows about 5% from the roughly $8.93 FY2026 ex-IPR&D level as HIV volume (Yeztugo, Biktarvy), Trodelvy and Livdelzi offset Veklury and pricing; the multiple stays below the current 18.8x because of the 2028 Biktarvy price cut.

bull.driver: Yeztugo and Trodelvy growth and pipeline (Arcellx, Tubulis, emvistegrast) lift EPS faster, and the 2028 pricing overhang is judged manageable, so the stock keeps a premium large-cap pharma multiple.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $9.40 the $168.08 close implies 17.9x (18.8x on the $8.93 FY2026 ex-IPR&D midpoint). The median of the six named targets (about $186) implies about 19.8x on $9.40 or about $11.30 EPS at 16.5x, and their simple mean (about $173) implies about $10.50 EPS at 16.5x; the Yahoo-sourced 26-analyst mean of $174.77 implies about $10.60 EPS at 16.5x. Consensus FY2027 EPS of about $10.14 (StockAnalysis summary box) would support a $167 value at 16.5x, close to today's price.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.40 (about 5.6 pp of the close). A $0.50 change in FY2027 EPS moves it by about $8.25 at 16.5x.
valuation.watch_metric: HIV franchise sales (Biktarvy and Yeztugo) growth and the FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance, including any acquired IPR&D charges, which the company has already raised to $12.4B for 2026.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results with first commentary on 2027, expected around early February 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Seven named analysts issued dated calls from Nov 2-12 2026 after the Oct 29 release: six targets from $131 to $200 (simple mean about $173) and seven Buy/Hold ratings, four Buy and two Hold plus RBC. Citi raised $180 to $188 and Leerink raised $129 to $145, with no cuts shown; RBC at $131 is the low and Scotiabank at $200 the high. Barclays (Hold, $160 from $145, Nov 16) is after the reference close and is excluded. The named-target mean sits about 12% above my base of $155.10, which equals roughly $1.10 of FY2027 EPS at 16.5x or about 1.2 turns of multiple. Horizons are undocumented, so no target enters a weighted average; the StockAnalysis aggregate also reports a Argus $85 prior that looks like a data error and is not used as a source_prior. Coverage is partial: StockAnalysis shows 8 rows including Barclays, and Yahoo reports 26 analysts, so the named set is a subset.
